CLAUDEGM.Settings.ApiKey.Name: Anthropic API key
CLAUDEGM.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Your key (sk-ant-...). Stored only in this browser, never sent to players.
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Model.Name: Model
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Model.Hint: Opus is the most capable; Sonnet is cheaper; Haiku is fastest and cheapest.
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Effort.Name: Reasoning effort
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Effort.Hint: More effort = more careful answers, but slower and more expensive.
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Confirm.Name: Confirm changes
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Confirm.Hint: Ask for approval before creating or updating documents and before posting public messages. Deletions and scripts always ask.
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Instructions.Name: Extra instructions
CLAUDEGM.Settings.Instructions.Hint: Free text sent to Claude in every conversation (e.g. campaign tone, house rules).
CLAUDEGM.NoKey: Set your Anthropic API key under Settings > Claude GM.
CLAUDEGM.Busy: Claude is still working on the previous request.
CLAUDEGM.Help:
/claude <request> — talk to Claude about the current world.

/claude! <request> — strongest model, more effort.

/ia <question> — quick model for simple questions.

/claude panel — open Claude's window.

/claude undo — revert the last request.

/claude stop — stop the running request.

/claude reset — start a new conversation.
CLAUDEGM.Truncated: (response cut off by the length limit)
CLAUDEGM.StepLimit: (stopped after many steps; ask me to continue if needed)
CLAUDEGM.Confirm.Title: Claude wants to make changes
CLAUDEGM.Settings.AllowPlayers.Name: Players can ask
CLAUDEGM.Settings.AllowPlayers.Hint: Lets players use /claude for questions ABOUT THEIR OWN SHEET (abilities, spells, items, features and the rules that apply to them). Claude only reads characters the player owns plus rules; it refuses lore, monsters, NPCs and secrets; it changes nothing. Limit: 1 question every 15 s and 20 per hour per player. You see every question and answer.
